claim: With every H4178 ablation switch ON (OILPALM_H4178_ABLATION empty) the H4178 launch environment reproduces the frozen stage-B version on scene 11, standard initial state, frame by frame.
code_level: frozen stage-B source tree verified file by file against STAGE_B_SOURCE_FREEZE.json (6b5fc107...1f34) before launch; zero bytes changed
hooks/sitecustomize.py imports nothing and patches nothing when OILPALM_H4178_ABLATION is empty; the run must contain NO 'installed'/'patched'/'redirected' event in H4178_HOOK_LOG.jsonl
known_nondeterminism: Frozen runs are NOT bit-identical: e.g. H4177212 vs H4177213 (same event pattern) differ by up to 2.4e-7 rad in joint_actual from frame 9 (GPU float32 reduction order). 'Identical' is therefore defined relative to the frozen run-to-run envelope.
discrete_criteria: (a) integrated frame count, CUT pre-steps, native release steps and exit steps of P2/P0/stalk1 equal those of at least one reference run (the 'matching references'); (b) the per-frame handoff state sequence equals that of a matching reference; (c) H4176 judge verdict passed with safety passed.
continuous_criteria: For every frame, compare with each matching reference: max |delta joint_actual| (rad), max |delta effective_surface_gap| over the 144 recorded pairs (m), max |delta body pose| over the 19 recorded body poses (position m, quaternion components with sign alignment). PASS if, for at least one matching reference, every statistic <= the envelope E = maximum of the same statistic over all pairs of reference runs sharing that event pattern (computed by envelope_reference.py from the frozen archives).
if_pattern_has_no_reference_pair: If the matching pattern has only one reference run, E is taken from the largest-population pattern.
failure_action: If the proof fails, the switches are NOT frozen; the failure is reported and investigated before any H4178 experimental run.
